notes.title: 80% weeklong discount
notes.content:
Hi! To promote Cursed Pantsu I am making a weeklong discount for Ecchi Jack and Ecchi Spirit.
It is the lowest price ever. If you are interested in the game, please consider buying it now.

notes.title: Cursed Pantsu demo available right now
notes.content:
Our new game Cursed Pantsu is participating in the Steam Next Fest. You can try the demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733620/Cursed_Pantsu/]here[/url].

Kaori is a good girl who always does the right thing. But one day, succumbed to temptation, she had stolen panties in the Mall...
Cursed Pantsu is a story-driven action-adventure game with RPG and platforming elements about Kaori’s adventures in the Hellish Mall.

notes.title: The game was released!
notes.content:
We had released Ecchi Spirit a few minutes ago.
Everyone, thank you for the patience! We made sure to prevent any game-breaking bugs and fine-tune the game balance. 

Your feedback is essential for us. Let us know what you think about the game in your reviews or community discussions. We are planning to improve the game in future updates.

notes.title: The release is delayed to May 8
notes.content:
I am very sorry, but it is impossible to release the game today. I found a game-breaking bug that requires some time to fix.
But don't worry, it is only a brief delay. The game will be definitely released on May 8.

notes.title: The release is planned to May 4
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. I would like to apologize for the delay. Right now the game is playable, but it is still too early to present it to players.
Don't worry, the game will be fully complete by May 4.
